name: wwp-film-workflow
description: Repo-local Codex skills and helpers for WWP film and series production workflows.

interface.shortDescription: Route WWP intake, metadata, playable video, Notion, and Media Assets work.
interface.longDescription: Project-local Codex workflow rules for explicit human/AI handoffs, ingesting new resources, preventing duplicate works, maintaining metadata-first catalog entries, selecting films and series, creating work/spec/episode pages early, encoding browser-compatible playable MP4 variants, resumably uploading them to Notion, writing Media Assets, verifying live website sync, backfilling manual uploads, handling source archives, and filling structured film metadata through identity, Douban, OMDb, TMDb, and AI advisory lanes. Series delivery defaults to one file per episode; collections require an explicit instruction.
interface.defaultPrompt: When the user says 开始制作影视库, run the complete WWP workflow from registered input roots through metadata, playable production, Notion publishing, Media Assets, and final readback verification.
